stem: Which markup correctly associates the visible text 'Email address' with a text input?

options.rationale: The label's `for` value matches the input's `id`, so assistive technology announces the label as the input's name.
A `<div>` is not a label, so the text is not associated with the input.
A placeholder disappears when the user types and is not a reliable accessible name.
The label does not wrap the input and has no `for` value, so the two elements are not associated.

explanation: A `<label>` is associated with a control when its `for` attribute matches the control's `id`, or when it wraps the control. A placeholder is not a label: it disappears when the user types and is not a reliable accessible name. A `<div>` is not a label at all.
author: Oxypteros
